title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Priya Patel
description: Context: Add curated RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to help developers onboard to Redwood's agent tooling. This PR includes new example repos under redwood-examples and docs site updates for RAG patterns, tool calling, and canonical quickstarts. Motivation: lower friction for customers to build retrieval-augmented generation and tool-enabled agents by providing tested templates and step-by-step guides. Changes: - New templates: conversational_rag, summarization_rag, multi-tool-agent - Tool-calling examples using HTTP and local tool connectors - Quickstart guides for the docs site with code snippets, diagrams, and troubleshooting notes - Minor API docs clarifications for tool schema and function calling contract - CI/test harness updates for example integration tests Checklist: - [x] Implement templates and examples - [x] Add docs pages and sidebars - [x] Add integration tests for examples - [x] Update docs site navigation - [x] Add release notes and changelog entry Related: ENG-8945, DOCS-77, and previous RAG quickstart PRs. Deployment notes: Docs site rebuild required (Netlify). No infra changes. Follow-ups: 1) Add additional language bindings for the examples (Go/Java) 2) Add a brief tutorial video linked from the quickstart pages
commits: Add initial RAG templates and agent examples (6 files)
Docs: add quickstarts and sidebar entries
Fix: address linter errors in examples
Tests: add integration smoke tests for examples
review_comments: Alex Kim: Nice end-to-end examples — left a few nit comments on the tool schema examples. Please add an example of error-handling when tool calls time out.
Ruth Carter: Docs pages look good. Could we add a short table comparing the provided RAG templates and when to use each?
Diego Morales: Integration tests are helpful; one flaky test failed on first CI run due to timing — fixed by adding a wait and retry. Approving the PR after that fix.
